theorem mvcc.memberRes_lend (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (c
    : mvcc.CovArg) (hl : σ.live c.w) (hm : σ.M !! c.w = some c.γw) (he : σ.E !! c.w = some (c.evsw,
    c.d)) : mvcc.memberRes γ q σ c.w st ⊢ mvcc.covLent q.half c ∗ (mvcc.covLent q.half c -∗
    mvcc.memberRes γ q σ c.w st)

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroup_watchers_frac (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (q : Qp) :
    mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W q ⊢ ∃ v, typedPointsto wg v (DFrac.own q) ∗ mvcc.ownWatcherSet
    v.watchers' W.domSet q ∗ (typedPointsto wg v (DFrac.own q) -∗ mvcc.ownWatcherSet v.watchers'
    W.domSet q -∗ mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W q)

def mvcc.memberFacts (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs,
      ⌜σ.M !! w = some γw⌝ ∗
        mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗
          mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗
            (⌜¬σ.live w⌝ ∨
              ⌜σ.live w⌝ ∗
                mvcc.watcherChan γ w γw st.ch ∗
                  mvcc.watcherFilters γw fcs ∗
                    ∃ evsw d,
                      ⌜σ.E !! w = some (evsw, d)⌝ ∗ monoListLbOwn γw.evs evsw ∗ mvcc.popFacts γ σ w r γw.lo st evsw d))

theorem mvcc.memberFacts_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st :
    mvcc.WatcherSt) : Persistent (mvcc.memberFacts γ σ w st)

theorem mvcc.dedupL.eq_def (x✝ : List Loc) : mvcc.dedupL x✝ = match x✝ with | [] => [] | x :: xs =>
    if x ∈ xs then mvcc.dedupL xs else x :: mvcc.dedupL xs

theorem mvcc.memberFacts_of (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st :
    mvcc.WatcherSt) : mvcc.memberRes γ q σ w st ⊢ mvcc.memberFacts γ σ w st

theorem mvcc.mem_dedupL {w : Loc} {l : List Loc} : w ∈ mvcc.dedupL l ↔ w ∈ l

theorem mvcc.cov_entry_synced (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (rev : w64) (C : mvcc.Log) (w :
    Loc) (γw' : mvcc.WatcherNames) (hok : mvcc.WsOk σ) (hsy : (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true) (hC :
    List.length C ≤ List.length σ.Lmu) (hrev : sint.Z rev + 1 ≤ ↑(List.length C)) (hsb :
    σ.syncedBelow (List.length σ.Lmu)) (hrevE : ↑(List.length σ.Lmu) ≤ sint.Z rev + 1) (hsrb :
    σ.srBelow (List.length σ.Lmu)) (hg : ∀ (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames), σ.M !! w = some γw → γw.now =
    true ∨ ↑γw.lo ≤ sint.Z rev) : (□ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.ST, mvcc.memberFacts γ σ w st) ∗
    mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw' ⊢ ∃ c, ⌜c.w = w ∧ σ.M !! w = some c.γw ∧ σ.E !! w = some (c.evsw, c.d)⌝
    ∗ mvcc.covEntry γ γw'.wc rev c

theorem mvcc.nodup_dedupL (l : List Loc) : (mvcc.dedupL l).Nodup

theorem mvcc.cov_entries (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (rev : w64) (C : mvcc.Log) (γc :
    mvcc.WatchChanNames) (hok : mvcc.WsOk σ) (hC : List.length C ≤ List.length σ.Lmu) (hrev : sint.Z
    rev + 1 ≤ ↑(List.length C)) (hsb : σ.syncedBelow (List.length σ.Lmu)) (hrevE : ↑(List.length
    σ.Lmu) ≤ sint.Z rev + 1) (hsrb : σ.srBelow (List.length σ.Lmu)) (W : List Loc) : (∀ (w : Loc), w
    ∈ W → (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true ∧ ∀ (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames), σ.M !! w = some γw → γw.now = true
    ∨ ↑γw.lo ≤ sint.Z rev) → ((□ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.ST, mvcc.memberFacts γ σ w st) ∗ □ ∀ w, ⌜w ∈ W⌝
    -∗ ∃ γw', mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw' ∗ ⌜γw'.wc = γc⌝) ⊢ ∃ cs, mvcc.covPre γ γc rev cs ∗ ⌜List.map
    mvcc.CovArg.w cs = W ∧ ∀ (c : mvcc.CovArg), c ∈ cs → σ.M !! c.w = some c.γw ∧ σ.E !! c.w = some
    (c.evsw, c.d)⌝

def mvcc.covLent (q : Qp) (c : mvcc.CovArg) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListAuthOwn c.γw.evs q c.evsw ∗ dghostVar c.γw.live (DFrac.own q) true)

theorem mvcc.WatchParams.mk.congr_simp.{u_1} (IW IW✝ : Loc → IProp GF) (e_IW : IW = IW✝) (WC WC✝ :
    Loc → IProp GF) (e_WC : WC = WC✝) (C C✝ : GoChan → IProp GF) (e_C : C = C✝) (FI FI✝ : GoSlice →
    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool) → IProp GF) (e_FI : FI = FI✝) (RegCb RegCb✝ : GoChan →
    mvcc.WatchChanNames → mvcc.WatchRange → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool) → (Loc → IProp GF) → IProp GF)
    (e_RegCb : RegCb = RegCb✝) (CR CR✝ : GoChan → mvcc.WatchChanNames → List Loc → IProp GF) (e_CR :
    CR = CR✝) (R R✝ : IProp GF) (e_R : R = R✝) (T T✝ : IProp GF) (e_T : T = T✝) (IWF IWF✝ : Loc →
    mvcc.WatchRange → GoSlice → Nat → IProp GF) (e_IWF : IWF = IWF✝) (OC OC✝ : Loc →
    mvcc.WatchChanNames → IProp GF) (e_OC : OC = OC✝) (WS WS✝ : Loc → IProp GF) (e_WS : WS = WS✝)
    (IW_pers : ∀ (w : Loc), Persistent (IW w)) (WC_pers : ∀ (w : Loc), Persistent (WC w)) (C_pers :
    ∀ (ch : GoChan), Persistent (C ch)) (FI_pers : ∀ (fcs : GoSlice) (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)),
    Persistent (FI fcs fs)) (IWF_pers : ∀ (w : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice) (lo :
    Nat), Persistent (IWF w r fcs lo)) (OC_pers : ∀ (w : Loc) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames), Persistent
    (OC w γc)) (WS_pers : ∀ (w : Loc), Persistent (WS w)) : { IW := IW, WC := WC, C := C, FI := FI,
    RegCb := RegCb, CR := CR, R := R, T := T, IWF := IWF, OC := OC, WS := WS, IW_pers := IW_pers,
    WC_pers := WC_pers, C_pers := C_pers, FI_pers := FI_pers, IWF_pers := IWF_pers, OC_pers :=
    OC_pers, WS_pers := WS_pers } = { IW := IW✝, WC := WC✝, C := C✝, FI := FI✝, RegCb := RegCb✝, CR
    := CR✝, R := R✝, T := T✝, IWF := IWF✝, OC := OC✝, WS := WS✝, IW_pers := ⋯, WC_pers := ⋯, C_pers
    := ⋯, FI_pers := ⋯, IWF_pers := ⋯, OC_pers := ⋯, WS_pers := ⋯ }

theorem mvcc.members_lend (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (cs : List mvcc.CovArg) (ST
    : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) : (List.map mvcc.CovArg.w cs).Nodup → (∀ (c : mvcc.CovArg), c ∈ cs →
    σ.live c.w ∧ σ.M !! c.w = some c.γw ∧ σ.E !! c.w = some (c.evsw, c.d) ∧ (ST !! c.w).isSome =
    true) → ([∗map] w ↦ st ∈ ST, mvcc.memberRes γ q σ w st) ⊢ ([∗list] c ∈ cs, mvcc.covLent q.half
    c) ∗ (([∗list] c ∈ cs, mvcc.covLent q.half c) -∗ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ ST, mvcc.memberRes γ q σ w st)

def mvcc.dedupL : List Loc → List Loc :=
  List.brecOn x✝ mvcc.dedupL._f
